issues.legal_issue: An execution sale must be set aside when the evidence establishes that the auction was continued without an announcement to bidders and the sale price was grossly inadequate.
material_facts: The judgment debtors challenged the execution sale, alleging that the auctioneer had not announced that the auction would continue on a later day.
The auction record contained the auctioneer’s note that the auction would continue, but bidders had signed beside their individual bids rather than at the end of the record to acknowledge the note.
Eight people bid at the first sitting, but none of them attended the later sitting; only four people bid at that sitting.
The highest bidder from the first sitting testified that bidders were told the sale would be held later after notice was published, and that no next date was announced.
The auction purchaser did not call the auctioneer or any bidder from the first sitting as a witness, and could not name any person who had bid at that sitting.
The court found the price paid for the share sold to be totally inadequate.
issues.conclusion: The Court set aside the execution sale, finding that no announcement had been made that the auction would continue and that the price was totally inadequate.
issues.legal_principle: The Court inferred whether the continuation had been announced from the bid record, the absence of the earlier bidders at the later sitting, and the witness evidence. Because the substance of the auctioneer’s note was challenged, the purchaser’s failure to produce the auctioneer as the best evidence meant the courts below could not rely on the note alone. The Court also relied on the gross inadequacy of the price in setting aside the sale. No earlier case or specific provision was relied on to decide this issue.

rule.if: execution_sale_challenged and (earlier_bidders_absent and auctioneer_not_examined and witness_denied_announcement) and sale_price_grossly_inadequate

predicates.execution_sale_challenged: A party against whom a decree is being executed challenges the resulting court-conducted sale.
predicates.earlier_bidders_absent: Bidders who participated at the earlier auction sitting did not attend the later sitting at which the sale was completed.
predicates.auctioneer_not_examined: The purchaser did not call the auctioneer to testify about whether the continuation was announced.
predicates.witness_denied_announcement: A bidder from the earlier sitting testified that no date for the continuation was announced.
predicates.sale_price_grossly_inadequate: The court found that the price obtained for the property sold was grossly inadequate.
predicates.execution_sale_set_aside: The court sets aside the execution sale.

issues.definition: When a challenged execution sale is completed after an unannounced continuation, as supported by the absence of earlier bidders, the failure to examine the auctioneer, and testimony denying an announcement, and the sale price is grossly inadequate, the sale is set aside.
